zh-CN.title: SmartFit 智能健身助手
zh-CN.shortDescription: 浏览动作示范，安排本地训练计划，跟随计时、语音与提示音练习。
zh-CN.fullDescription:
SmartFit 为日常健身提供动作浏览、训练计划与跟练工具。

主要功能
• 浏览动作说明与示范，了解练习方式。
• 使用本地规则和模板安排训练计划，保存后再次练习。
• 跟随训练计时、语音指导和提示音完成练习。
• 在本机查看训练结果，调整外观和音频设置。

部分示范已内置，其他素材可通过 HTTPS 按需下载，并在校验后播放。下载需要网络和流量；可在设置中管理 Wi-Fi 下载与缓存。计时、语音不代表动作识别或姿势评估。

本版本不提供在线 AI 服务。无需注册账号，无广告，当前版本无购买或付费订阅。界面和语音指导主要为简体中文。

隐私
对话、计划、训练结果和偏好保存在本机。素材下载会向 Cloudflare 分发服务发送普通网络请求，包括 IP 地址、请求时间、请求的素材路径和 HTTP 元数据；不附加聊天、安全回答、完整训练记录、设备 UUID 或 AI 记忆。系统备份及设备迁移可能按设备和用户设置处理本地应用数据。详情请参阅隐私政策。

运动安全
SmartFit 用于一般健身示范，不是医疗器械，不提供疾病诊断、治疗、治愈或预防服务。存在伤病或其他运动风险时，请先咨询专业人士；训练中出现疼痛、头晕或胸闷等不适时，请立即停止。肌肉高亮仅为教学示意。

支持：mhgd3250905@gmail.com
隐私政策：https://smartfit-store.pages.dev/privacy/

en-US.title: SmartFit: Exercise & Workout
en-US.shortDescription: Follow exercise demos, local workout plans, timers, and spoken guidance.
en-US.fullDescription:
SmartFit offers exercise demonstrations, local workout plans, and tools for guided practice.

Features
• Browse exercise instructions and demonstrations.
• Use local rules and templates to arrange and save workout plans.
• Follow workout timers, spoken guidance, and chimes.
• Review results on your device and adjust appearance and audio preferences.

Some demonstrations are built in; other media can be downloaded over HTTPS and played after integrity checks. Downloads require connectivity and data. Manage Wi-Fi download preferences and media cache in settings. Timing and spoken cues do not provide movement recognition or posture assessment.

This version does not provide online AI responses. No account is required. There are no ads, purchases, or paid subscriptions in the current version. The interface and voice guidance are primarily in Simplified Chinese.

Privacy
Conversations, plans, results, and preferences are stored on your device. Media downloads send ordinary network requests to Cloudflare's delivery service, including an IP address, request time, requested media path, and HTTP metadata. The app does not attach conversations, safety answers, full workout records, its local device UUID, or AI memories to media requests. Operating-system backup and device transfer may process local app data according to your device and settings. See the privacy policy for details.

Exercise safely
SmartFit is for general fitness demonstrations. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent medical conditions. Consult a qualified professional if you have an injury or other exercise-related risks. Stop if you experience pain, dizziness, or chest discomfort. Muscle highlights are educational illustrations.

Support: mhgd3250905@gmail.com
Privacy: https://smartfit-store.pages.dev/privacy/en/
